meta.name: x-article-publisher
meta.description: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles editor with proper formatting. Use when user wants to publish a Markdown file/URL to X Articles, or mentions "publish to X", "post article to Twitter", "X article", or wants help with X Premium article publishing. Handles cover image upload and converts Markdown to rich text automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 文章发布到 X 并自动排版
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常写 Markdown 并想一键发布到 X 文章。
copy.tagline_en: Publish Markdown articles to X with auto formatting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write in Markdown and want to publish to X Articles in one click.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能读取 Markdown 文件，自动解析标题、封面图、正文，然后打开 X 的编辑器，填入标题和内容，保存为草稿。
howto.when: 当你要求发布 Markdown 文件到 X（Twitter），或提到“发布到 X”、“发文章到 Twitter”、“X 文章”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 文章发布到 X。
say.note: Claude 会解析文件并打开 X 编辑器保存草稿。

say.text: 帮我将 article.md 发到 Twitter 上。
say.note: Claude 会执行发布流程，最终保存为草稿。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read a Markdown file, automatically parse the title, cover image, and body, then open X's editor, fill in the title and content, and save as a draft.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to publish a Markdown file to X (Twitter), or mention "publish to X", "post article to Twitter", "X article", etc.

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown article to X.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the file and open X editor to save a draft.

say_en.text: Post article.md to Twitter for me.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the publishing workflow and save as draft.
